hook: Anthropic just made Claude Sonnet faster, smarter, and cheaper.
spoken_script: Anthropic just made Claude Sonnet faster, smarter, and cheaper. Anthropic launched Claude Sonnet 5.5, the new frontier daily workhorse for developers. It features a massive one-million-token context window, one-hundred-twenty-eight-k output tokens, and thirty percent faster generation. On Terminal-Bench four-point-zero, it scored seventy point six percent, outperforming prior models on agentic coding while keeping pricing at two dollars per million tokens. The developer daily driver just got supercharged. Follow AI News Factory for daily verified AI breakthroughs.
